# ghost/google_maps

Google Maps — search places and fetch directions with per-mode ETA and distance

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/google_maps
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps get_directions --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps open_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps search_place --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps open_directions --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps select_travel_mode --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps read_route_summary --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/google_maps close_card --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `get_directions`: Search a destination and return route summary (ETA, distance, per-mode times)
- `open_app`: Force-stop Google Maps and relaunch to the explore/home screen
- `search_place`: Type a place into the search box and land on its place card
- `open_directions`: Tap the Directions button on an open place card
- `select_travel_mode`: Select a travel mode tab (driving / transit / walking / cycling)
- `read_route_summary`: Parse the directions screen into structured route data
- `close_card`: Close the current place card or directions view
